capabilities.methodology: Predefined parameterised templates matched via local TF-IDF (1-2 word + 3-5 char n-grams) and RapidFuzz over precomputed SQLite catalogs. No runtime LLMs or free-form SQL generation.
supported_topics: Category delay rankings and comparisons (SUB, MEX, SUF, VNDB, etc.)
Hourly arrival patterns (0-23 IST) and weekday variations
Station delay hotspots with Wilson 95% confidence intervals
Train timetable deep dive and worst-supported route stops
Model transparency and evaluation metrics (AP, ROC-AUC, threshold)
unsupported_topics: Ticket booking, PNR status, seat availability, or IRCTC accounts
Live GPS train running tracking or real-time location
Physical causality claims (fog, signaling failures, track maintenance)

supported_intents.description: Overall Indian Railways fleet delay statistics and total monitored volume.
Dataset date window, label definitions (>15m threshold), and audit boundaries.
Rankings of train service classifications by observed delayed rate.
Specific delay statistics and volume for a single train category (e.g. SUB, MEX, VNDB).
Direct comparison between two train classifications (e.g. Suburban vs Express).
Hour of day delay patterns (0-23 IST) showing temporal fluctuations.
Day of week delay patterns (Monday-Sunday) and weekend vs weekday differences.
Delay progression as trains advance along their route sequence (early vs deep journey).
Observed delay hotspots or most punctual stations across the network.
Observed worst delayed or most punctual train services across the fleet.
Detailed timetable, delay rate, and mean delay for a specific train.
The worst delayed stops and stations along a specific train route.
Historical delay rate, total calling trains, and calling train sample for a station.
Direct comparison between two specific trains on punctuality and average delay.
Day-by-day delay rate trends across the 19-day historical collection window.
Overview of the machine learning delay prediction model, evaluation metrics, and features.
Queries asking for future trip delay predictions or booking advice, redirecting to Tab 3.
Causal queries asking why trains are late, signaling issues, fog, or physical causes.
